pages.text: $(l:world/royal_synthesis)Royal synthesis$() creates this compact mining companion. It starts in Wait, inherits parental growth, and spends half the ordinary stamina in every policy. Normal excavates its chunk; Ore Priority favors visible ores in the active layer. Its side crest leaves room for a headlamp and safety goggles.
pages.title: Next-Generation Mining Slime

pages.text: Choose Precision Prospecting and enable the desired Forge ore tags in its Tuner. It digs a 2×2 shaft, detects selected ores through walls, and excavates supported 2×2 branches toward them. Rising or descending branches use safe steps. Exposed selected ores come first; access rock also enters its bag.

Liquids, unsupported cavities, protected stairs, and unsafe roofs constrain its route. It tries a bypass or pauses if none is safe. Ordinary tools, durability, cargo pickup, and work warnings apply. The Scanner previews the shaft and next face. No access ladder is built; provide a return route for transport companions. Recovered slimes redeploy in Wait.
